title: GPU-Accelerated Secure Inference for Drug--Target Interaction Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.25664v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning models that predict drug--target interactions (DTI) can speed up drug discovery, but the candidate drugs they score are valuable intellectual property that their owners cannot reveal. Secure multiparty computation (MPC) lets two servers compute a prediction on a secret-shared drug, without either server learning the drug. However, secure inference of deep models is slow. Non-linear operations require communication between the servers, and MPC arithmetic does not map naturally to GPUs. In this paper, we present our solution to Track~III of the iDASH 2026 privacy and security competition, which asked for fast two-party secure DTI inference on GPUs. Our solution is built on the co-design of MPC-friendly models and MPC protocols. translated_title: GPU加速的药物-靶点相互作用预测安全推理
translated_abstract: 预测药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）的深度学习模型可以加速药物发现，但模型所评分的候选药物属于机密知识产权，其所有者无法公开泄露。安全多方计算（MPC）允许两个服务器对一个以秘密共享形式存在的药物进行预测计算，而任何一方服务器都无法获知该药物的真实内容。然而，深度模型的安全推理速度很慢：非线性操作需要服务器之间进行通信，且MPC算术无法自然地映射到GPU上。本文提出了针对iDASH 2026隐私与安全竞赛第三赛道的解决方案，该赛道要求在GPU上实现快速的两方安全DTI推理。我们的解决方案建立在MPC友好模型与MPC协议的协同设计之上。在模型方面，我们设计了SlimDTA，这是一种能够减少对秘密药物所执行操作的DTI模型，尤其是减少需要通信的非线性操作。在协议方面，我们构建了……
tldr: 该论文针对iDASH 2026竞赛提出了GPU上的两方安全推理方案，通过协同设计MPC友好的DTI模型SlimDTA与MPC协议，实现快速的隐私保护药物-靶点相互作用预测，避免候选药物知识产权泄露。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated two-party secure inference solution for drug-target interaction prediction, co-designing an MPC-friendly model called SlimDTA with MPC protocols to enable fast, privacy-preserving DTI inference for the iDASH 2026 competition.
